initial_state.tagline: A simulated travel site. Every hotel, review score and reservation here is invented; nothing is booked and nothing is charged.

lis-miradouro-hotel.title: Hotel Miradouro da Graca - Lisbon, 4 stars
bullets: Free cancellation until 3 days before arrival
lis-miradouro-hotel.description: Price per night for a double room with a city view. Rooftop terrace over the castle hill, air conditioning, a small gym and a bar that does a decent bica. Tram 28 stops at the corner. Free cancellation until 3 days before arrival, then the first night is charged.

reviews.author: carol
reviews.title: The terrace view is the whole city
reviews.body: Room was quiet despite the tram. Breakfast had proper pastel de nata. The hill is steep; take the tram up.

lis-alfama-apartment.title: Alfama Rooftop Apartment - Lisbon, entire apartment
bullets: Alfama, river view from the roof
Non-refundable rate, 15% below the flexible rate
lis-alfama-apartment.description: Price per night, one-bedroom apartment on the fourth floor with no lift and a private rooftop over the Tagus. Self check-in with a lockbox. This rate is non-refundable; the flexible rate is $152 a night.

lis-baixa-hostel.title: Baixa Central Hostel - Lisbon, private double
bullets: Free cancellation until the day before
lis-baixa-hostel.description: Price per night for a private double with a shared bathroom on the floor. Rooftop bar, free walking tour every morning at 10:00, luggage storage. Cancel free until 18:00 the day before arrival.

kyo-machiya-gion.title: Gion Machiya Tsubaki - Kyoto, traditional townhouse
bullets: Gion, 6 minutes' walk to Yasaka Shrine
Free cancellation until 7 days before arrival
kyo-machiya-gion.description: Price per night for the whole restored machiya: two tatami bedrooms, a small inner garden and a hinoki bath. Futons made up nightly on request. Free cancellation until 7 days before arrival, then 50%.

reviews.author: alice
reviews.title: Worth every yen
reviews.body: The bath after a day of temples is the reason to book this. Quiet lane, and the host left a hand-drawn map of the neighbourhood.

kyo-station-hotel.title: Kyoto Station Karasuma Hotel - 3 stars
bullets: Shimogyo, 5 minutes' walk to Kyoto Station
Free cancellation until 1 day before arrival
Compact double, public bath on the top floor
kyo-station-hotel.description: Price per night for a compact double, 16 square metres. Public bath on the ninth floor, coin laundry, breakfast buffet for $14. Ideal for day trips: Nara and Osaka trains are five minutes away.

kyo-arashiyama-ryokan.title: Arashiyama Riverside Ryokan - Kyoto, half board
bullets: Kaiseki dinner and breakfast for two included
kyo-arashiyama-ryokan.description: Price per night for two, kaiseki dinner and breakfast included. River-view tatami room with an outdoor bath. Check-in 15:00, dinner served in the room from 18:30. Cancellations inside 14 days are charged in full.

mex-roma-boutique.title: Casa Jacaranda - Mexico City, boutique hotel in Roma Norte
bullets: Roma Norte, 2 blocks from Alvaro Obregon
Free cancellation until 2 days before arrival
mex-roma-boutique.description: Price per night for a courtyard king. Twelve rooms in a 1920s house, a jacaranda tree in the patio and breakfast under it. Airport pickup can be added at check-out for $38.

mex-condesa-loft.title: Condesa Park Loft - Mexico City, entire loft
bullets: Free cancellation until 5 days before arrival
mex-condesa-loft.description: Price per night, one-bedroom loft on the third floor with a balcony over the park. Set up for working: a proper desk, a second screen and 400 Mbps fibre. Coffee shops on every corner.

reviews.author: bob
reviews.title: Great for a work week
reviews.body: Wifi held up on every call. Parque Mexico dog walkers start early, so bring earplugs if you sleep late.

mex-centro-grand.title: Gran Hotel Zocalo Vista - Mexico City, 5 stars
bullets: Free cancellation until 1 day before arrival
mex-centro-grand.description: Price per night for a superior room. The stained-glass atrium is the reason people book; the rooftop restaurant over the square is the reason they stay in for dinner. Breakfast $24.

rey-harbour-hotel.title: Reykjavik Old Harbour Hotel - 4 stars
bullets: Old Harbour, whale-watching pier 3 minutes away
Free cancellation until 2 days before arrival
rey-harbour-hotel.description: Price per night for a standard double. Harbour-facing rooms have blackout blinds for the summer light. The hot tub on the terrace is fed from the city's geothermal supply. Winter aurora wake-up calls on request.

rey-laugavegur-apartment.title: Laugavegur Studio - Reykjavik, entire studio
bullets: Miobaer, on the main shopping street
rey-laugavegur-apartment.description: Price per night, studio for two above a bookshop on Laugavegur. Underfloor heating, a kitchenette that makes the grocery-store prices bearable, and a bus to the airport from the corner. Non-refundable; the flexible rate is $196.

rey-guesthouse-ada.title: Guesthouse Ada - Reykjavik, double with shared bathroom
bullets: Vesturbaer, 10 minutes' walk to the centre
Free cancellation until 3 days before arrival
rey-guesthouse-ada.description: Price per night for a double with a shared bathroom. Family-run, six rooms, a kitchen guests actually use and free parking, which matters if you are driving the ring road. Breakfast is $16 and worth it.

reviews.author: carol
reviews.title: Ada knows everything
reviews.body: She rebooked our glacier tour when the weather turned and the skyr at breakfast is homemade.

nyc-midtown-tower.title: Midtown Tower Hotel - New York, 4 stars
bullets: Midtown West, 6 minutes' walk to Times Square
Free cancellation until 1 day before arrival
nyc-midtown-tower.description: Price per night for a queen room on floors 20-38, plus a $35 resort fee at check-out. Rooms are small and the views are not; ask for a north-facing floor above 30. Breakfast $29.

nyc-brooklyn-brownstone.title: Fort Greene Brownstone Suite - Brooklyn, private floor
bullets: Fort Greene, 3 minutes to the C train
Free cancellation until 7 days before arrival
nyc-brooklyn-brownstone.description: Price per night for the garden floor of an 1880s brownstone: bedroom, living room with a sofa bed, full kitchen and the back garden. Hosts live upstairs. Manhattan is 15 minutes on the C.

nyc-les-boutique.title: The Orchard Street Hotel - New York, boutique, Lower East Side
bullets: Lower East Side, 2 blocks from Delancey St station
Rooftop bar, record player in every room
nyc-les-boutique.description: Price per night for a standard king with a Bluetooth turntable and a small library of records at the front desk. Rooftop bar closes at 01:00 on weekends, and the rooms below it hear that. Non-refundable rate.

nyc-queens-budget.title: Long Island City Inn - Queens, 2 stars
bullets: Long Island City, 1 stop to Manhattan on the 7
Free cancellation until 1 day before arrival
nyc-queens-budget.description: Price per night for a double. Clean, plain, and one stop from Grand Central on the 7 train. The free parking is the reason drivers book it; the free breakfast is bagels and coffee.
